name: Lake Malawi National Park
story: Lake Malawi National Park is situated at the southern end of Lake Malawi in Malawi, Southeast Africa. Covering approximately 95 square kilometers, the park includes a headland, the foreshore, and several small rocky islands. It is home to diverse wildlife such as chacma baboons, leopards, hippopotamuses, and crocodiles.
matters: Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1984, the park is of global importance for biodiversity conservation due to its remarkable fish diversity. It shelters hundreds of endemic cichlid fish species that provide an outstanding example of evolution at work.
